summary: Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 9, 2026 to report the completion of its acquisition of The Container Store Holdings, LLC. The merger closed on July 8, 2026, with Merger Sub merging into TCS, leaving TCS as a wholly owned subsidiary. Consideration details (price per share, total value) are not disclosed in the excerpt. The board recommended the transaction. A Registration Rights and Lock-Up Agreement provides holders with shelf registration, demand (minimum $25M), and piggyback rights. The filing also notes convertible notes and a letter agreement. Monitor integration progress and any post-merger stock movements for risk-arb implications.
